title: resolve_content does sync I/O on async paths
description: resolve_content (posting.rs:85-102) uses std::fs::read_to_string for file-backed content, which blocks the async runtime. This is called from load_status (posting.rs:828), account_statuses (api.rs:1080), the outbox handler (activitypub.rs:538), profile_page (activitypub.rs:322), and every timeline endpoint. On a busy timeline request with file-backed posts, this could block the tokio worker thread for the duration of multiple disk reads. Should use tokio::fs::read_to_string and make resolve_content async, or use spawn_blocking.
